parts.t: FULLY RENOVATED RANCHER TOWNHOUSE inside the highly sought-after community of Douglas Point! Walk into your wide-open floor plan with 12FT vaulted ceiling throughout the living/dining room! This 2 bed 2 bath features a NEW kitchen, NEW appliances, NEW hardware & doors, updated light fixtures, NEW oversized flooring & moldings! The washrooms are completely renovated! FIR Ceiling beam & Fir Mantle in the living area! Custom Millwork throughout & even EPOXY coating in the garage! A fully fenced Sunny west facing yard is perfect for pets, kids, or entertaining. Meticulously maintained & proactive strata. This complex has an amazing clubhouse & offers RV parking just minutes to White Rock beach, Peach Arch Park, and Peace Portal golf course!
